title: Carpet Area vs Built-Up Area vs Super Built-Up Area: RERA Rules and a Worked Example
seoTitle: Carpet Area vs Built-Up Area vs Super Area: RERA Rules
seoDescription: Carpet area is the usable floor RERA defines; built-up adds walls, super area adds common areas. Turn a super-area quote into price per usable sq ft.
excerpt: What RERA section 2(k) counts and leaves out, a two-flat example that turns super-area rates into price per usable sq ft, why loading percentages differ, and the state-wise area variation clause.
